name: Anantara Stanley and Livingstone Victoria Falls Hotel
positioning: Boutique safari hotel inside a private game reserve, 15 minutes from Victoria Falls on the Zimbabwe side
best_for: Travelers who want Big Five game drives and black rhino conservation alongside a Victoria Falls visit
Couples wanting a suite with a private heated pool

facts.text: The hotel is situated within a 4,500-hectare private game reserve.
The hotel is on Old Ursula Road, 15 minutes from Victoria Falls on the Zimbabwe side.
The hotel is a 20-minute drive from Victoria Falls Airport.
The hotel describes itself as a boutique African retreat on the edge of Victoria Falls.
Each suite is crafted with the heritage of Zimbabwe in mind.
Suites offer a private veranda with a view.
The hotel has an Anantara Spa and wellness sanctuary.
The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool.
1871 Restaurant offers gin tasting, a chef's table, wine pairing and afternoon tea along with local and international dishes.
The hotel welcomes families, with family accommodation and kids' activities.

highlights.text: Stays include access to Big Five game drives and guided nature walks.
The hotel offers a black rhino conservation experience.
Suites with a private heated pool are available.
Guests can volunteer with the Nakavango Conservation Programme at the reserve, gaining hands-on experience in the wild and the local community.
The hotel hosts Bush Boma dinners and starlit evenings.

considerations.text: The hotel is 15 minutes from Victoria Falls, not beside it.
The hotel asks families to help maintain a peaceful environment for all guests.
The hotel is not pet-friendly and offers only limited parking for hotel guests.
